scope: Two deliberate prior-test contract updates: add reasoning.effort to the exact OpenRouter keyed-path set, and narrow registry conformance from rejecting every direct dotted path to rejecting only direct use of the wrapper-reserved provider_params.* namespace. New append-only tests separately prove keyed-value separation and unknown dotted-key bypass; the pre-existing provider_params wrapper-isolation regression remains unchanged and green.
reason: OME-1656 adds one output-affecting direct dotted rule. The exact-set tripwire must name it. The old conformance assertion encoded a broader restriction than dispatch: direct dotted paths were declared unreachable even though only provider_params.* is structurally wrapper-only. Owner explicitly approved both changes on 2026-10-19; the narrowed assertion is acknowledged here rather than described as unchanged.
